desc:
wAIrrior is the AI warrior that watches every app and machine your business runs, spots irregularities, and contains the attack on its own. (Submitted earlier as NoKey.)

Contain first, ask later: anything reversible wAIrrior does on its own in seconds; anything irreversible waits for the owner. Then the owner hears: "You were attacked. We already did X, Y, Z. Tap to undo."

This week: on 2 Nov attackers remotely forced supermarket freezers across Europe into defrost, up to 50 C (Tom's Hardware, CBS, Al Jazeera; links in repo). A defrost is a legitimate command; static rules let it pass. On 4 Nov Credit Mutuel Arkea suspended transfers for all clients after fraudulent operations (EUR 118M is a press figure, unconfirmed). Without fine-grained containment, the only brake is switching everything off. In October, our own AI keys were abused for ~16 hours (USD 310).

The Sentinel screen shows the business on one timeline: a combined wave contained per app while normal work continues, then the owner's WhatsApp notice. Connect any app with one SecurityEvent webhook.

Text is not a security boundary, so before an agent acts on a machine, wAIrrior verifies physically: a thermal twin predicts the product temperature, history included; the verdict depends on physics. Measured (repo): on 1,000 generated simulated scenarios the predictive shield stopped 419/419 damaging actions (static rules 7/419; false blocks 23/581; p50 1.6 ms). A three-round physical red team published and closed every bypass, including a forged rescue that now needs an HMAC-signed grant. Spark, asked to attack, produced 20 plans: static rules pass 8 of 11 damaging plans; physics stops all heat damage. In the Arkea-pattern autopilot bench (simulated, evals/autopilot/REPORT.md @ 50a667e), attacks go to zero while 263 of 300 legitimate writes stay alive; suspending everything keeps 0 of 300. Live on 4 Nov, Spark refused an injected "defrost 4 h, door open" document and the gate blocked that action (breach at 45 min, simulated physics). SAM 3.1 counted 7/7 boxes and detected the open door (labeled test images). On 3 Nov, live: stolen token 200 -> 401 in 70.8 s (synthetic voice approval in the browser); separately, the owner's real WhatsApp voice note approved a live rotation (run live_c31aa0ec5ef2).

Honest limits: the twin is a labeled model, not real equipment; no real actuator is connected. Demo (replay, no sign-in): https://bendrix-shield-panel-290240328973.us-central1.run.app/
use:
- Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta Model API): reasoning, tool calling, invoice vision, per-document policy review, guardian plan, owner's voice intent, the refrigeration controller, incident triage (live, USD 0.014644, evals/recorded/autopilot-spark-triage-2026-11-04.json) and attacker: Spark generated the 20 attack plans in evals/physical/SPARK-ATTACKER.md (live generation, simulated evaluation). Controller: evals/recorded/physical-live-2026-11-04-defrost-r2.json.
- SAM 3.1 (Meta Model API, /v1/responses): warehouse counting and the physical scene (boxes, door) feeding the twin. Live: 7/7 boxes and open door detected on labeled AI-generated test images (evals/recorded/physical-sam-2026-11-04.json, physical-sam-door-2026-11-04.json).
- Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0: owner voice approvals for irreversible or marginal steps only. Live: synthetic TTS in the browser take, owner's real WhatsApp voice note on 3 Nov.
- WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta): after-containment owner notice and voice approvals. Live, tested 3 Nov.
- Muse Wonder 1.0: hard triage of ambiguous exposures. In code; no recorded live call.
- Muse Image 1.0: labeled AI-generated test images only.
- Muse Spark Open (open weights): output-gate classifier. In code; NOT run (no partner credits).
- Muse Code: coding agent used for part of the development, with Claude Code and manual edits. Not a runtime component.
Only Meta models are called at runtime.
why: One model family covers the whole loop through one API behind one gateway, and one warrior watches all of it. SAM 3.1 gives Warehouse its eyes, and those same eyes tell the thermal twin how much product is inside and whether the door is open. Muse Spark reads invoices, reviews documents, reasons as the guardian, proposes physical actions, writes the owner's incident notice, and even generated the attack plans we measured the shield against. Muse Voice Transcribe turns the owner's spoken yes into the approval that unlocks only what is irreversible. Because each agent has its own token on the same gateway, containment stays fine-grained: one token rotates, one defrost is blocked, one payment is held, and the rest of the business keeps working, which is exactly what a bank that had to suspend every client transfer did not have this week. And no text model supplies this on its own: a physical prediction. The models propose and explain; physics decides; wAIrrior contains first and asks later.
